content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue where the weekly timer's on/off time parameters do not retain their remanence when the [product_name] is turned off. The settings only save if I change them directly on the device display. Is there a way to ensure remanence for these timer parameters by default? Changing parameters via [product_name] Web Editor or HMI seems to result in the loss of remanence, while direct changes on the device keep them. Assistance in solving this problem would be appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]
Please upload your [product_name] program along with your Web Editor or HMI project in a zip file.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is encountering inconsistent parameter remanence for a weekly timer on [company_name] [product_name] devices: when parameters are adjusted via the [product_name] Web Editor or HMI, the on/off times are lost after restart, whereas direct edits on the device display are properly retained. This decreases confidence in remote parameter changes and highlights reliability concerns for remote configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects changes to weekly timer parameters made through the [product_name] Web Editor or HMI to persist with the same reliability as those made directly on the device's display.
